problem:
The matrix $A$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(A).$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}$, where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2}$ are the respective columns of $A.$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ \,\,-2 & \,\,-2 \\ \,\,-1 & \,\,-1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}\,\,-4 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Column Space of a Matrix
